p: A wide 3:2 illustration in exactly the style of the first reference image: deep near-black background, coral-red and pink hand-inked swirls, crisp line work. A pair of full red lips, slightly parted as if speaking, with two small curved sound arcs on each side, drawn correctly and believably with every part in the right place, sitting on the right half of the picture. The left 45 percent stays dark and nearly empty so text can sit there. Fewer swirls than the second reference image. No text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere.
